caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with a slanted top, commonly known as a bureau. The main color is a light brown with a prominent wood grain pattern visible across all surfaces of the bureau. The front of the desk has four drawers with the top row comprising two smaller drawers side by side, and three larger drawers below, each with ornate metal keyhole plates and pull handles in a silvery color. The sides of the bureau are a deeper reddish-brown tone, contrasting with the lighter wood grain of the front and top. The desk sits on four round, dark-colored bun feet. A rectangular outline frames the entire drawing, and the artist’s name “CHAS SQUIRES” is written in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Desk
